question.problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$S=[\begin{aligned}0 & 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 2 & -5 & 4 \\ 4 & 0 & 2 & 2\end{aligned}].$
question.worked_solution:
We use the cofactor expansion along the first row:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(S) & ={s}_{11}{C}_{11}+{s}_{12}{C}_{12}+{s}_{13}{C}_{13}+{s}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =0\cdot {C}_{11}+2\cdot {C}_{12}+0\cdot {C}_{13}+0\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & =2{C}_{12} \\  & =2\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & 2 & ∗ & ∗ \\ 1 & ∗ & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & ∗ & -5 & 4 \\ 4 & ∗ & 2 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =2(-1)^{1+2}|\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & -5 & 4 \\ 4 & 2 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =-2(1\cdot |\begin{aligned}-5 & 4 \\ 2 & 2\end{aligned}|-0\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 4 \\ 4 & 2\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & -5 \\ 4 & 2\end{aligned}|) \\  & =-2((-5\cdot 2-4\cdot 2)-0+0) \\  & =-2\cdot (-18) \\  & =36\end{aligned}
$$
